lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regularly spaced high-luminance circular clusters arranged in multiple parallel longitudinal rows along the mid-to-posterior lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Discrete vertical pixel bands of elevated intensity intersecting with longitudinal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid structure across the mid-body.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A linear horizontal feature with a high-contrast luminance gradient—characterized by light dorsal values and shadowed ventral values—extending longitudinally along the upper flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparsely distributed high-intensity local maxima visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.
